resources.string: Laptop server se connection establish karo settings se

Kaise lagaye:

1. Laptop pe AK chalao (AK Voice Assistant).
2. Wahan se ak_server.py start karo.
3. Laptop ka LAN address yahan daalo, e.g. http://192.168.1.5:4097
4. Wahi password daalo jo server start karte waqt console pe aaya.
5. Test connection dabao - green ho to ho gaya.

Laptop aur phone ek hi WiFi pe hone chahiye. Remote access ke liye Tailscale use karo.
